bank.retain_mission: Extract overall LifeOS strategic goals (TELOS framework: IDEAL_STATE, CURRENT_STATE), Digital Assistant peer identity guidelines, explicit user preferences, system architectural invariants, Anti-Criteria forbidden failure modes, and long-term project vision. Ignore intermediate subagent thought chains, raw terminal outputs, line-level code patches, transient debugging output, and boilerplate.
bank.observations_mission: Track active TELOS goal progress, ongoing task state, user intent alignment, Anti-Criteria compliance, Ideal State Criteria test outcomes, system architectural boundaries, and Digital Assistant peer interactions over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a strategic alignment briefing summarizing current TELOS goals, active Ideal State Criteria, Anti-Criteria constraints, user preferences, Digital Assistant persona guidelines, and key architectural invariants.
